m1.typescript: m1 a transient failure is retried locally and the success is reported with its attempts

e1.typescript: e1 a valid empty result is a success with no findings and never an error

e2.typescript: e2 a permission or invalid query error is not retried and carries what was attempted and its alternatives

e3.typescript: e3 a failure that survives the retries carries the partial results of the last attempt

e4.typescript: e4 the coordinator uses partial results tries an alternative or flags a gap and never stops the run

e5.typescript: e5 the coverage note separates supported topics from gaps and names the cause

e6.typescript: e6 a topic with no result is a gap that was not searched

wrong-empty-is-error.defect: reports a search with no matches as a failure

wrong-retry-permission.defect: retries a permission error as if it were transient

wrong-drop-partial.defect: throws away the partial results of a failed search

wrong-generic-error.defect: reports only that the search failed, without its type and the query attempted

wrong-stop-on-failure.defect: abandons the whole run when one topic failed

wrong-gap-as-supported.defect: lists a failed topic among the well-supported ones

wrong-missing-topic-skipped.defect: leaves a topic that was never searched out of the note
